There are two `NotificationChannel` interfaces (one in `monitoring`, one in `application`), with the following implementations:

RELEVANT_FILES_START
monitoring/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/monitoring/notification/channels/impl/SlackNotificationChannel.java | implements monitoring's NotificationChannel interface
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/notification/channels/MicrosoftTeamsNotificationChannel.java | implements application's NotificationChannel<MicrosoftTeamsNotificationTargetConfig, MicrosoftTeamsDeliveryMethodNotificationTemplate>
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/notification/channels/SmsNotificationChannel.java | implements application's NotificationChannel<User, SmsDeliveryMethodNotificationTemplate>
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/notification/channels/EmailNotificationChannel.java | implements application's NotificationChannel<User, EmailDeliveryMethodNotificationTemplate>
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/notification/channels/MobileAppNotificationChannel.java | implements application's NotificationChannel<User, MobileAppDeliveryMethodNotificationTemplate>
application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/notification/channels/SlackNotificationChannel.java | implements application's NotificationChannel<SlackConversation, SlackDeliveryMethodNotificationTemplate>
RELEVANT_FILES_END
